shortDescription: Stacked z-levels as ONE BIG MAP (sky/surface/basement). Full vanilla parity via ~100 Harmony patches. Pass 42: tier-1 static gates (AnyLevelColumns/AnySky/AnyBasement) short-circuit the hot cross-level patches on a single static read in zero-column games. Green build.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## PROJECT DOCS (2026-07-26) — keep alive
- **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** (mod root): the living map of the system — layered dependency graph, boot/lifecycle sequence, the "ONE BIG MAP" request-interception pattern, per-module reference table, cross-cutting patterns, refactor backlog (R1–R5). USER-OWNED; update it in the same change as any structural shift (new module, new tick hub, changed `LevelExtensions`/`ABGuard` API). Diagrams are Mermaid.
- **`docs/generate-helicopter-view.sh`** → `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` (gitignored, ~1.88 MB, 171 files): concatenates the whole codebase into one md for whole-project chats. Regenerate before such a chat.
- **Metrics (2026-07-26):** 156 C# files / 41,982 LOC + 14 Defs/Patches XML / 1,428 LOC ≈ **43.4k LOC of code**. 110 declarative `Patch_*` + 24 imperative compat patches = 134 patch points. 19 `ABGuard` kill switches. Largest files: `Dev/ABDevTools.cs` (2,559), `Logistics/CrossLevelDemand.cs` (1,489), `Rendering/LevelRenderer.cs` (1,260).
- **Architecture spine (for quick recall):** `Levels/LevelExtensions.cs` (`map.Levels()`/`GroundMap()`/`SameColumn()`) is the most-depended-on type; `Core/ABGuard` is second. Two tick hubs — `Core/ABGameComp` (game) and `Levels/LevelComp.MapComponentTick` (map) — both reach UP into feature modules to dispatch (the one deliberate layer inversion, refactor R1).

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**; add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk. Build a column via "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" — **the pin gets culled at startup ("Could not find node… Removing", harmless RimWorld quirk for Playing-gated debug actions); run it from the Debug Actions menu instead**. Diagnostic: **"AB: explain haul decision"** (ToolMap).

## PERF — TIER-1 STATIC GATES (pass 42, 2026-07-26)
Global cheap gates live on `LevelComp`, keyed to the current `Game` via a `WeakReference` (a stale count from an abandoned game reads false, never wrong): `AnySkyLevels`, `AnyBasementLevels` (new), and `AnyLevelColumns` (= sky||basement count > 0). Counts are maintained in `LevelComp.FinalizeInit`/`MapRemoved` via `NoteLevel(lvl, delta)` (was sky-only `NoteSkyLevel`); a pocket map (level != 0) only ever exists linked to a ground, so `AnyLevelColumns` is the universal "any multi-level column exists" gate.
- **Idiom:** each hot cross-level patch's FIRST check is `if (!LevelComp.AnyLevelColumns …) return;` (or `return true;` for skip-prefixes). The gate is a **superset** of every patch's real precondition, so it is strictly behavior-preserving — in a zero-column game (the common case) the patch bails on one static int read before touching the per-map `Levels()` CWT lookup. Reads `Current.Game` short-circuit-last, count-first.
- **Build B, NOT physical unpatch:** patches stay installed; we early-out. Physical `Unpatch`/re-`Patch` was rejected (DrawPosOffsetPatcher patches hundreds of getters that run on ParallelPreDraw worker threads; re-emit poisoning risk on a published mod).
- **Gated hot set (~27 entry points):** need-migration `ThinkNode_JobGiver.TryIssueJobPackage`, `JobGiver_Work`, Areas (`InAllowedArea` prefix + raw/effective restriction getters + `GetAllowedArea` + `SeekAllowedArea`), `Map.IsPlayerHome`, `PsychicBondProximity`, `WorldObject.Tile` + storyteller wealth/pawns getters, `Pawn.GetGizmos`, gear (3 givers via shared `ABGearAcrossLevels.Gate`), joy, learn, gatherings, mech charge/command/escort, `ColonistBar.CheckRecacheEntries`, PawnTable+Animals `Pawns` getters, below thing-overlays, mouseover-readout below, `Targeter` OnGUI/Update hover, `SelectionDrawer.DrawSelectionBracketFor`.
- **Already gated (untouched):** render patches (`LevelRenderer.OffsetActive` static bool), `ClimatePatches`/`LevelSync`/`PodTransit` (`AnySkyLevels`), the `LevelComp` MapComponent tick (per-level `Due()` + static count early-outs).
- **Deliberately NOT gated (event-driven, not polling):** click/drag selection handlers, area setter/`Notify_AreaRemoved`, trade/caravan/ritual-gather/incident-divert.

## LEVEL NAVIGATION / INPUT
Manual level switching all funnels through `LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView(Map)` (preserves camera pos+zoom, selection, and open Architect build tool via `ABArchitectPreserve`; sets `ManualSwitch=true` so it bypasses the camera level lock). Inputs handled in `ABGameComp.GameComponentOnGUI` (runs BEFORE `CameraDriverOnGUI` in `Root.OnGUI`):
- **`AB_ViewLevelUp`/`Down`** keybinds (PageUp/PageDown default), rebindable, category `AB_Keys`. VERIFIED working.
- **`AB_CameraLevelLock`** (End default) — toggles `LevelCamera.LevelLocked`; suppresses only AUTOMATIC switches. Gated by setting `cameraLockKeybind`.
- **Left CTRL + mouse wheel over the map** = move up (scroll up) / down. Gated by setting `scrollLevelKeybind` (default on, View & camera tab). Skips when cursor is over a window. Left Ctrl only.
  - **WHY CTRL, NOT SHIFT (2026-07-26):** Shift+wheel is rerouted onto the HORIZONTAL scroll axis by the OS/Unity IMGUI, which zeroes the vertical wheel entirely — on this user's system even `Input.mouseScrollDelta.y` read 0 under Shift (and it's why vanilla camera zoom also dies under Shift). Two Shift attempts failed (`Event.current.delta.y`, then `Input.mouseScrollDelta.y`). Ctrl+wheel is NOT rerouted, so the vertical wheel is intact.
  - **IMPL:** standalone `if` (not the KeyDown else-if chain), reads `Input.mouseScrollDelta.y` (raw device wheel, POSITIVE = up), frame-stamped (`lastScrollLevelFrame` vs `Time.frameCount`) so the many OnGUI passes/frame switch once, consumes the ScrollWheel event when present (Ctrl+wheel would otherwise zoom). Verbose-logging line prints `[AB] ctrl+wheel <val> -> <target>`.

## STAIRS FLOAT MENU — single "go up/down" order (2026-07-26 fix)
Two systems both added a travel order when a stairwell was right-clicked, so the player saw **two** entries (most obvious on stuffed stairs: "Go up via steel wide stairs up" + "Go up the stairs"):
1. `Building_ABStairs.BuildUseOptions` (the building's own `GetFloatMenuOptions`) → clean **"Go up/down the stairs"** + greyed reasons (not-linked/forbidden/no-path). This is the CANONICAL source.
2. `CrossLevelOrders.AddStairsTravelOption` (Harmony postfix on `FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions`, added 2026-07-24) → **"Go up/down via {LabelShort}"** (`AB_GoUpVia`), which on a stuffed stair renders the material name.
- **FIX:** the postfix's duplicate-guard now also **yields to the base option** — it skips adding when any existing option label `== label` OR `StartsWith("AB_GoUp".Translate())` OR `StartsWith("AB_GoDown".Translate())`. So the clean base option wins in the normal case (including the greyed no-path/forbidden variants), and the "via X" option survives only as a fallback when the base one didn't fire (stairwell just outside the thing-select radius). Elevators (Building_ABElevator, up+down) are covered too. Green build 0/0, awaiting retest.

## ART — stair/ladder/elevator texture pass (2026-07-26, MORTON)
Imported external retexture pack (`Textures/Things/Building/AB_*`) + MORTON's graphic settings into `Defs/Buildings/AB_Stairs.xml` (grafted texture settings only, preserved gameplay). 27 files, all directional (+dedicated stair `_west`), single icons for uiIconPaths. Stale `AB_Elevator_AB_Elevator.png` removed. Preserved Forbiddable/rotatable=false/ladder-flag/WideStairs.

## PUBLISH STATE (2026-07-26)
Workshop UPDATE (PublishedFileId `3767572810`). Green build 0/0. Hygiene: stubs.json empty, no pdb, no shipped 0Harmony.dll, Assemblies holds only `AsAboveSoBelow.dll`, About.xml complete (supportedVersions 1.6, Harmony dep, incompatibleWith MultiFloors/ZLevels/Strata). Preview.png 1280x720 (predates art pass). NOTE: workspace `Source/` had been stripped for publish; restored from git HEAD this session (needed for the ctrl+scroll work).

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX + DOCTRINE B (consumables)
**CORE:** `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs vanilla's full storage search (no reachability/virtual-swap) and is Harmony-patched by LWM/Adaptive Storage — modded storage honored for free, any level queryable cheaply.
- **`ColumnStorage.cs`:** `TryFindBetter` runs that search on every level, keeps the single best; crosses only for a strictly-higher tier elsewhere.
- **DOCTRINE B:** consumables follow one-big-map STORAGE priority into the best stockpile, fetched CROSS-LEVEL AT USE TIME. Only ACTIVE location-specific work pre-positions a stack (blueprints, live bill/surgery ingredients, refuel, transporter loads, food for an IMMOBILE consumer). MOBILE pawns register no pull.
- **THE FIX (3 parts):** reverted a misdiagnosed `constructionOnly` gate; `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` issues the next relay hop directly; `DeliveredHere` pins only a stack that actually LANDED IN STORAGE.
- **Phase 3/4 (PENDING):** event-driven upgrade driving at scale; work-migration reads ColumnStorage.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch · **PageUp/PageDown level nav**.

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000 (p39) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
- **PERF GATES (pass 42, retest):** regression only — with NO column built, everything behaves exactly as before (areas/zones, work, joy, mech, colonist bar order, pawn tables, below-view overlays/selection all vanilla). Then build a column and confirm every cross-level feature still fires (they should: gate is a superset of each patch's precondition). If a cross-level feature silently stops firing, suspect the gate ran before its map's `LevelComp.FinalizeInit` noted the count (load-order window) — same theoretical window as the shipped `AnySkyLevels` sky-temp gate, unobserved in practice.
- **STAIRS FLOAT MENU (retest):** right-click a colonist, then right-click a STUFFED stairwell -> exactly ONE "Go up the stairs" order (no "via steel …" duplicate). Repeat for down stairs, ladders, elevators. Forbid a stair -> single greyed "(forbidden)". Wall off a stair -> single greyed "(no path)".
- **INPUT (ctrl+scroll, retest):** with a built column, hold Left Ctrl + scroll over the map -> view moves up/down one level per notch, no zoom; plain scroll still zooms; ctrl+scroll over an open window scrolls that window; at top/bottom the wheel is eaten; toggle off in View tab -> ctrl+scroll zooms again; works with camera lock ON. If still broken, enable Advanced->verbose logging and read `[AB] ctrl+wheel …`.
- **ART:** build each stairs/ladder/elevator, confirm architect icons + ghost use new single-icon art (no magenta), south facing, rotate N/E/**W**.
- **PASS 41:** FOOD/MEDICINE + Critical stockpile 2 gaps away (forces relay) -> must MOVE into Critical and stay. Regression: chunks cross; equal-tier no-cross; designation gate; downward relay no stall; PUAH no loop; bill/surgery ingredient still supplied cross-level.

## Status
2026-07-26: **Authored `ARCHITECTURE.md` + helicopter-view generator** (living system map: layered dependency graph, boot sequence, ONE-BIG-MAP interception pattern, module table, refactor backlog R1–R5). Total code ≈ 43.4k LOC. Earlier same day: **PASS 42** tier-1 static gates on ~27 hot cross-level patches (Build B, green 0/0); fixed double stairs float-menu; MORTON art pass; ctrl+scroll level nav (shift failed twice); Workshop update 3767572810. PageUp/PageDown confirmed working.
